newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran says Israel holds 4 of its diplomats in jail.
newsitem.headline: Iran says Israel holds 4 of its diplomats in jail.

text.p: Iran said on Sunday four Iranian diplomats kidnapped in 1982 were being held in an Israeli jail.
Iranian television monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation said Iran's ambassador in Lebanon, Homayun Alizadeh, made the statement after a meeting with Lebanon's finance minister.

"Our country's ambassador in Lebanon said that the Iranian diplomats are in the prisons of the Zionist regime," the television reported. "Mr Alizadeh said: We are continuing our efforts to obtain precise information."
The television said Iran's charge d'affaires Seyyed Mohsen Musavi and the three other diplomats were kidnapped about 15 years ago in Lebanon.

The Prisoner's Friends Society, a Nazareth-based organisation which works on behalf of prisoners in Israel, told Reuters on Friday that Israel was secretly holding four Iranians believed to have been kidnapped by a pro-Israeli militia in Lebanon since 1982.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's spokesman Shai Bazak said it was not true.
